summary.plain: A ball of fast plastic scintillator tiles around a target where muons stopped, recording when each muon decay produced a positron.
summary.technical: Segmented plastic-scintillator positron detector with ferromagnetic and quartz stopping targets and a kicked muon beam; pi E3 beamline.
